P1: The search was requested for 30 days but evaluated only for the last 12 days (status partial). The 120 refunds all to one country come from only 12 days of data. We cannot say whether refunds to other countries occurred in the first 18 days. So: Cannot tell.

P2: The link took effect at 09:40 Monday but was learned at 15:00 Monday. The check scored at 10:00, before the system learned of the link. So the evidence was not available to the check at 10:00, even though it was effective. The check did not miss available evidence. Answer: No.

P3: Does a rise from 1 to 6 percent warrant review? A sixfold increase in refund rate for a merchant being asked about is reasonably worth review. Review is a low-cost action, and the question is about whether it warrants review, not whether it is fraud. Yes.

RESULT PN-016 | P1: Cannot tell | P2: No | P3: Yes
